## Summary
- Add `delphi_ili_fluview` weighted ILI percentage \(`delphi_fluview_wili`\) as a new flu indicator in the respiratory bundle
- Simplify epiweek-to-date conversion in `delphi_ili_fluview/ingest.R` \(use direct date addition instead of manual MMWR week calculation\)
- Clean up commented-out experimental code in `bundle_respiratory/build.R`
- Rebuild bundle parquet outputs with updated flu trends

## Test plan
- [ ] Verify `flu_overall_trends.parquet` includes the new `delphi_fluview_wili` variable
- [ ] Confirm ILINet data aligns temporally with other flu indicators
- [ ] Check that existing COVID and RSV outputs are unaffected

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code]\(https://claude.com/claude-code\)
EOF
\)")

Bash("/c/Program Files/R/R-4.4.1/bin/Rscript.exe" -e '
library\(dplyr\)
data_raw <- vroom::vroom\(""raw/exemptions.csv.xz"", delim = "","", show_col_types = FALSE\)

dupes <- data_raw %>%
  filter\(geography == ""county""\) %>%
  mutate\(
    geography_fips = stringr::str_pad\(as.character\(fips_ihme\), width = 5, pad = ""0""\),
    time = paste0\(""09-01-"", year\),
    time = format\(as.Date\(time, format = ""%m-%d-%Y""\), ""%m-%d-%Y""\)
  \) %>%
  select\(geography_fips, time, exemption_type, pct, county_name, state_name, fips_ihme, fips_census\) %>%
  group_by\(geography_fips, time, exemption_type\) %>%
  filter\(n\(\) > 1\) %>%
  arrange\(geography_fips, time, exemption_type\) %>%
  ungroup\(\)

cat\(""Total duplicate rows:"", nrow\(dupes\), ""\\n""\)
cat\(""Unique FIPS codes with duplicates:"", n_distinct\(dupes$geography_fips\), ""\\n\\n""\)

cat\(""Sample duplicates:\\n""\)
print\(dupes %>% head\(30\), n = 30, width = 200\)

cat\(""\\n\\nDo duplicates have different county names for same FIPS?\\n""\)
dupes %>%
  distinct\(geography_fips, county_name, state_name, fips_census\) %>%
  group_by\(geography_fips\) %>%
  filter\(n\(\) > 1\) %>%
  arrange\(geography_fips\) %>%
  print\(n = 40, width = 200\)
')
